newsitem.title: MOROCCO: MOROCCO'S BOURSE ENDS WEEK 0.48 PCT HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: MOROCCO'S BOURSE ENDS WEEK 0.48 PCT HIGHER.

text.p: Morocco's bourse ended the week on Friday 0.48 percent higher, boosted by active trading in blue-chip firms, including largest ONA Group, brokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 660.97 points against 657.83 points on the previous session.
"The bourse index is continuing its rising trend due to the expected positive prospects of listed stocks," a trader said.
Largest capitalisation firms such as ONA and BMCE bank rose five and 17 dirhams to 835 dirhams and 598 dirhams respectively.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, which has diversified stakes in more than 40 firms, ended the week at 767 dirhams, up six dirhams over the previous session.
Giant steel mill Sonasid jumped 16 dirhams to 572 dirhams.
Credit firm Magrebail gained 32 dirhams to close at 565 dirhams.
Cement firm Lafarge, one of largest cement groups, rose 37 dirhams to close at 1,273 dirhams.
Total trading volume rose to 64 million dirhams, from 54.7 million dirhams on Thursday.
Exchanges on the official market were up to 23.6 million dirhams from 21 million dirhams on the previous session.
